summary: Python pipeline: SEC EDGAR → XBRL JSON API → time-series financial schema → Monte Carlo stochastic DCF. Future: options valuation (Black-Scholes, real options).
xbrl_path: SEC XBRL JSON API — data.sec.gov/api/xbrl/companyfacts/CIK{padded_cik}.json. Primary parse path. Raw .txt EDGAR downloads are archival fallback only.
dcf_direction: Stochastic DCF via Monte Carlo (numpy). Fit growth/margin/WACC distributions from historical data. Output P10/P50/P90. Architecture must support future options valuation extension.
current_focus: options valuation extension (Black-Scholes, real options) — future
dcf_implementation: financial_analysis/dcf.py — StochasticDCF + DCFAssumptions + DCFResult. Vectorized numpy Monte Carlo (default 10k sims, 10y). Samples growth/FCF-margin/WACC/terminal-growth. FCF margin derived from last 5 annual periods if not given. Annual (10-K) periods only. Min-history guard: requires >=4 annual periods with positive FCF, else ValueError (blocks post-IPO/loss-makers). CLI: scripts/run_dcf.py. Loads from store, no live API call at valuation time.
fcf_sign_note: capex is stored sign-flipped (negative) by the importer; schema.free_cash_flow uses OCF - abs(capex). Fixed 2026-06-12 (was overstating FCF by 2x capex).
smoke_test_policy: Every ticket requires a live smoke test before closing. A ticket is not done until real output is printed and confirmed consumable by the next ticket.
notes: Agents should be concise when updating README.md and context.json.
